name: Document
definition: General information that unambiguously identifies a document, such as identification number and issue date time.

CopyDuplicate.name: Copy Duplicate
CopyDuplicate.definition: Specifies if this document is a copy, a duplicate, or a duplicate of a copy.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Specifies the type of the document, for example commercial invoice.

Amount.name: Amount
Amount.definition: Amount of money and currency of a document. |The amount can be either the original amount due and payable for instance the ordered amount, or the amount actually remitted for the referred document.

DocumentVersion.name: Document Version
DocumentVersion.definition: Unambiguous identification of the version of a document.

Status.name: Status
Status.definition: Status of the document (eg delivered, paid, etc.)

DataSetType.name: Data Set Type
DataSetType.definition: Specifies the type of data set in which the document is included.

SignedIndicator.name: Signed Indicator
SignedIndicator.definition: Indication whether the document must be signed or not.

RemittedAmount.name: Remitted Amount
RemittedAmount.definition: Amount of money remitted for the referred document.

Language.name: Language
Language.definition: Language used for textual information in the document.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Specifies the function of the document.

PlaceOfStorage.name: Place Of Storage
PlaceOfStorage.definition: Specifies where the document is stored.

PaymentObligation.name: Payment Obligation
PaymentObligation.definition: Document which is referred to in a payment obligation.

Agreement.name: Agreement
Agreement.definition: Agreement which is materialised by a document

PlaceOfIssue.name: Place Of Issue
PlaceOfIssue.definition: Place where the document was issued.

Reconciliation.name: Reconciliation
Reconciliation.definition: Reconciliation process for which a document is specified.

LetterOfCredit.name: Letter Of Credit
LetterOfCredit.definition: Written undertaking by a bank to honour a demand for payment.

PartyRole.name: Party Role
PartyRole.definition: Role played by a party in the context of a document or in the context of the business linked to the document.

Transport.name: Transport
Transport.definition: Transport process for which related documents are specified.

Guarantee.name: Guarantee
Guarantee.definition: Guarantee that is described in a document.

DocumentIdentification.name: Document Identification
DocumentIdentification.definition: Identification of a document for instance unique identification of the purchase order, assigned by the buyer.

Evidence.name: Evidence
Evidence.definition: Proof of evidence which uses a document.

CommercialTrade.name: Commercial Trade
CommercialTrade.definition: Trade for which a certificare is issued.

RelatedContract.name: Related Contract
RelatedContract.definition: Related document which materialises the agreement.
